annotations.title: List the AI apps connected to this account

description: The AI assistants and MCP clients signed in to this Hermoso account (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, the CLI's browser sign-in and others) that still hold a live token: name, the host they connected from, when they were authorised and last used, how many tokens. Needs a whole-account admin key you created (an app connected by sign-in cannot list its siblings). Read-only, free.
name: list_connected_apps
title: List the AI apps connected to this account
